description: Options dashboard's own Strategy Catalog roster -- separate from the stocks leaderboard.json (strategies do not carry over between dashboards). Contest window is computed dynamically (most recently completed full year) -- see domain/leaderboard/baselines.py's contest_window_for_year(). live_season_start is a FIXED anchor, not recomputed: the Live Trading Leaderboard tracks profit from this date forward (up to 1 year), and must not itself roll with 'today' or the window could never accumulate any elapsed days -- see domain/options/leaderboard_service.py's module docstring.
